data.case_title: Conditional admission offer – MSc Embedded Systems (Beispielwetzlar Graduate School of Engineering)
data.explanation: This is a conditional admission offer: it only becomes final once the school has verified your bachelor's degree. You need to upload a certified copy of your bachelor's certificate and your final transcript to the applicant portal by the deadline shown. If these documents don't arrive by then, the offer automatically lapses, so make sure to upload them in good time. If you already submitted them, it's worth checking the portal to confirm they were received.
